values.meaning: Mana restored when target dies while infected

mechanics.claim: The dot refreshes upon damaging the target with Call of the Void or Nether Grasp.
mechanics.quote: which refreshes upon damaging them with ''{{ai|Call of the Void|Malzahar}}'' or ''{{ai|Nether Grasp|Malzahar}}''

mechanics.claim: If the infected target dies, the debuff spreads to the closest nearby enemy and grants mana; not relevant to a single dummy fight.
mechanics.quote: If the target dies while infected, they spread ''Malefic Visions'' onto the closest nearby enemy and '''Malzahar''' restores a portion of {{sti|mana|{{as|his '''maximum''' mana}}}}

mechanics.claim: Malefic Visions deals persistent, indirect damage and applies spell effects.
mechanics.quote: ''Malefic Visions'' deals {{tip|persistent damage}}, additionally tagged as {{tip|indirect damage}}, and applies {{tip|spell effects}}

mechanics.claim: The cast is not cancelled if the target becomes untargetable, dies, or leaves range/sight during the cast time, but the debuff is not applied if the target is untargetable when the cast completes.
mechanics.quote: ''Malefic Vision's'' cast is special cased to not be cancelled if the target becomes {{tip|untargetable}}, {{tip|death|dies}}, or is too far away or no longer in {{tip|sight}} during the cast time.
